value.rationale: The result converts a component-spectrum theorem into a uniform topological symmetry theorem: regardless of which countable Anti-Foundation model is chosen, its double-membership automorphism group contains every finite-group wreath profile with S_infinity. This exposes a strong common symmetry lower bound despite large global non-categoricity.
